content:
## PURPOSE
Answer questions about Valtera Motors customer calls and surveys (synthetic data, 2026-08-22 to 2026-11-20): complaint topics, sentiment, safety signals, emerging issues, dealers and the escalation queue.

## DISAMBIGUATION
- "Interactions", "contacts", "complaints" mean distinct calls or surveys. One interaction can mention several topics: count totals in gold_interaction_insights, mentions per topic in gold_topic_daily.
- "Recent", "this month", "last 30 days" are relative to the latest date in the data (2026-11-20).
- A model named without a year means all model years. Powertrain is EV, HYBRID or ICE; hybrids are not ICE.

## DATA QUALITY NOTES
- nps_score exists only for surveys; calls have NULL.

## CONSTRAINTS
- Never return customer names, emails, phone numbers or VINs.

## Instructions you must follow when providing summaries
- Round percentages to 1 decimal. Mention the date range in the text of the answer; do not add date columns to the query result.

question: Weekly mentions of a topic for a vehicle
sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', interaction_date) AS week, SUM(interactions) AS mentions FROM daria_krasavina.voc_valtera.gold_topic_daily WHERE topic_name = :topic AND model = :model AND model_year = :model_year GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

parameters.name: topic
description: Leaf topic name

parameters.name: model
description: Vehicle model

parameters.name: model_year
description: Model year

usage_guidance: Trends of one topic over time: gold_topic_daily, SUM(interactions).

question: How many escalation cases are still open, by priority?
sql: SELECT priority, status, COUNT(*) AS cases FROM daria_krasavina.voc_valtera.gold_case_status GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY priority, status
usage_guidance: Case handling (status, assignee, notes from the app): gold_case_status. Open = no action saved yet.

question: Show what customers said about a topic
sql: SELECT sentence_text, detected_by, matched_terms, ai_confidence FROM daria_krasavina.voc_valtera.gold_sentence_topics WHERE topic_name = :topic ORDER BY ai_confidence DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 20

parameters.name: topic
description: Leaf topic name

question: Top complaint topics for a powertrain between two dates
sql: SELECT topic_name, SUM(interactions) AS mentions FROM daria_krasavina.voc_valtera.gold_topic_daily WHERE powertrain = :powertrain AND parent_topic <> 'Positive Feedback' AND interaction_date BETWEEN :start_date AND :end_date GROUP BY topic_name ORDER BY mentions DESC LIMIT 10

parameters.name: powertrain
description: EV, HYBRID or ICE

parameters.name: start_date
description: First day (YYYY-MM-DD)

parameters.name: end_date
description: Last day (YYYY-MM-DD)

question: Open P1 and P2 cases by topic group
sql: SELECT primary_parent_topic, priority, COUNT(*) AS cases FROM daria_krasavina.voc_valtera.gold_escalation_queue GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY priority, cases DESC

question: Safety interactions and negative rate by vehicle (metric view)
sql: SELECT model, model_year, MEASURE(safety_interactions) AS safety_interactions, MEASURE(negative_rate_pct) AS negative_rate_pct FROM daria_krasavina.voc_valtera.mv_voc_metrics GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY safety_interactions DESC
usage_guidance: Governed KPIs by dimension: mv_voc_metrics with MEASURE().

question: Dealers with the highest share of negative interactions
sql: SELECT dealer_name, COUNT(*) AS interactions, ROUND(100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN sentiment = 'negative' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS negative_pct FROM daria_krasavina.voc_valtera.gold_interaction_insights GROUP BY dealer_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50 ORDER BY negative_pct DESC LIMIT 10
usage_guidance: Rates per dealer: require a minimum volume.

question: Which issues are spiking right now?
sql: SELECT topic_name, model, model_year, first_alert_date, peak_lift, last_7d FROM daria_krasavina.voc_valtera.gold_emerging_issues WHERE is_alert ORDER BY peak_lift DESC
usage_guidance: Emerging / spiking / trending issues: always gold_emerging_issues with is_alert.

sql: ROUND(100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN gold_interaction_insights.sentiment = 'negative' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1)
ROUND(100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN gold_interaction_insights.nps_score <= 6 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 1)

question: How many interactions came from Gold tier customers?

content: SELECT COUNT(*) AS interactions FROM daria_krasavina.voc_valtera.gold_interaction_insights WHERE loyalty_tier = 'Gold'

question: Which 3 dealers have the most P1 cases in the escalation queue?

content: SELECT dealer_name, COUNT(*) AS p1_cases FROM daria_krasavina.voc_valtera.gold_escalation_queue WHERE priority = 'P1' GROUP BY dealer_name ORDER BY p1_cases DESC LIMIT 3

question: When was the charge port door problem on the 2026 Aurora EV first detected?

content: SELECT first_alert_date FROM daria_krasavina.voc_valtera.gold_emerging_issues WHERE topic_name = 'Charging - Charge Port Door Stuck' AND model = 'Aurora EV' AND model_year = 2026

question: What is the detractor rate for surveys?

content: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN nps_score <= 6 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 1) AS detractor_rate_pct FROM daria_krasavina.voc_valtera.gold_interaction_insights WHERE channel = 'survey'

question: Which dealer has the most poor dealer experience complaints?

content: SELECT dealer_name, SUM(interactions) AS complaints FROM daria_krasavina.voc_valtera.gold_topic_daily WHERE topic_name = 'Dealer - Poor Dealer Experience' GROUP BY dealer_name ORDER BY complaints DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which active emerging issue has the biggest spike versus its baseline?

content: SELECT topic_name, model, model_year, peak_lift FROM daria_krasavina.voc_valtera.gold_emerging_issues WHERE is_alert ORDER BY peak_lift DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many interactions were there for the Strata EV, all model years?

content: SELECT COUNT(*) AS interactions FROM daria_krasavina.voc_valtera.gold_interaction_insights WHERE model = 'Strata EV'

question: How many interactions came from calls and how many from surveys?

content: SELECT channel, COUNT(*) AS interactions FROM daria_krasavina.voc_valtera.gold_interaction_insights GROUP BY channel

question: How many emerging issue alerts are active?

content: SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_alerts FROM daria_krasavina.voc_valtera.gold_emerging_issues WHERE is_alert

question: How many interactions mentioned a charge port door problem for the 2026 Aurora EV?

content: SELECT SUM(interactions) AS interactions FROM daria_krasavina.voc_valtera.gold_topic_daily WHERE topic_name = 'Charging - Charge Port Door Stuck' AND model = 'Aurora EV' AND model_year = 2026

question: What percent of interactions are negative for each powertrain?

content: SELECT powertrain, ROUND(100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN sentiment = 'negative' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS negative_pct FROM daria_krasavina.voc_valtera.gold_interaction_insights GROUP BY powertrain

question: What is the average NPS by vehicle model, all model years combined?

content: SELECT model, AVG(nps_score) AS avg_nps FROM daria_krasavina.voc_valtera.gold_interaction_insights WHERE channel = 'survey' AND nps_score IS NOT NULL GROUP BY model

question: How many tagged sentences were found only by the AI classifier and not by the rules?

content: SELECT COUNT(*) AS ai_only FROM daria_krasavina.voc_valtera.gold_sentence_topics WHERE detected_by = 'ai'

question: How many unexpected braking mentions were there for the 2026 Aurora EV in November 2026?

content: SELECT SUM(interactions) AS mentions FROM daria_krasavina.voc_valtera.gold_topic_daily WHERE topic_name = 'Safety - Unexpected Braking' AND model = 'Aurora EV' AND model_year = 2026 AND interaction_date BETWEEN '2026-11-01' AND '2026-11-30'

question: How many P1 cases are in the escalation queue?

content: SELECT COUNT(*) AS p1_cases FROM daria_krasavina.voc_valtera.gold_escalation_queue WHERE priority = 'P1'

question: What share of P1 cases in the escalation queue are vehicle safety cases?

content: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN primary_parent_topic = 'Vehicle Safety' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS safety_share_pct FROM daria_krasavina.voc_valtera.gold_escalation_queue WHERE priority = 'P1'

question: Which complaint topic has the most mentions overall?

content: SELECT topic_name, SUM(interactions) AS mentions FROM daria_krasavina.voc_valtera.gold_topic_daily WHERE parent_topic <> 'Positive Feedback' GROUP BY topic_name ORDER BY mentions DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which dealer region has the highest average NPS?

content: SELECT dealer_region, AVG(nps_score) AS avg_nps FROM daria_krasavina.voc_valtera.gold_interaction_insights WHERE channel = 'survey' AND nps_score IS NOT NULL GROUP BY dealer_region ORDER BY avg_nps DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the average escalation score of P1 cases in the queue?

content: SELECT AVG(escalation_score) AS avg_escalation_score FROM daria_krasavina.voc_valtera.gold_escalation_queue WHERE priority = 'P1'

question: How many safety-related interactions were there in October 2026?

content: SELECT COUNT(*) AS safety_interactions FROM daria_krasavina.voc_valtera.gold_interaction_insights WHERE is_safety AND interaction_date BETWEEN '2026-10-01' AND '2026-10-31'
